  "chunks": [

      "chunk_type": "isnad",
      "arabic_text": "عَنْهُ عَنْ صَفْوَانَ وَ فَضَالَةَ عَنِ الْعَلاَءِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ قَالَ",
      "translations": {
        "en": "From him, from Safwan and Fadala, from al-Ala', from Muhammad ibn Muslim, who said:"
      }
    },
    {
      "chunk_type": "body",
      "arabic_text": "سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ الرَّجُلِ يَتَكَارَى الْأَرْضَ مِنَ السُّلْطَانِ بِالثُّلُثِ أَوِ النِّصْفِ هَلْ عَلَيْهِ فِي حِصَّتِهِ زَكَاةٌ قَالَ «لَا» قَالَ وَ سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ الْمُزَارَعَةِ وَ بَيْعِ السِّنِينَ فَقَالَ «لَا بَأْسَ».",
      "translations": {
        "en": "I asked him about a man who leases land from the ruler for one-third or one-half; is there zakat on his share? He said, 'No.' I asked him about al-muzara'ah (sharecropping) and the sale of years (leasing for a fixed period), and he said, 'There is no harm.'"
      }
    }
  ],
